title: Juicy Slovakian Tofu Dumplings
description: A pungent and gooey Slovakian dish featuring lemon and coconut cream, perfect for a post-workout meal. This jain-friendly recipe is steamed to perfection in a bamboo steamer.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the crumbled tofu, lemon juice, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the coconut cream and flour until smooth.
Add the flour mixture to the tofu mixture and stir until a dough forms.
Gradually add the water to the dough and knead until a sticky ball forms.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Place the balls into a bamboo steamer lined with parchment paper.
Steam the dumplings over boiling water for 15 minutes.
Serve the dumplings hot with a side of coconut cream crack.
Garnish with lemon wedges and chopped fresh herbs if desired.
